_readme: Common Excel wording and style shared by every method (README, Management_Summary, engine sheets Assumptions / Sources / Open_Questions, claims sheet). Method deliverables.<lang>.json adds the `deliverables` block; both are deep-merged with <run>/overrides/deliverables.<lang>.json, then the override `patches` are applied.

style: valantic palette only (DESIGN §7). status keys: standard | rework | rebuild | neutral | assumption. Header tiers: normal | decision | support. Tab roles: result | assumptions | reference | internal.

readme.subtitle: {engagement.consultancy} for {engagement.client} – {engagement.title}
readme.basis_intro: Every result row states its basis in the column “Basis”:
readme.basis_code: “Code” – a location in the repository (path relative to the checkout, with a line range where useful)
readme.basis_vendor: “Vendor documentation” – a source [Qn] listed on the sheet “{sources_sheet}” with title, address and check date
readme.basis_assumption: “Assumption (A-nn)” – a premise listed on the sheet “{assumptions_sheet}” that {engagement.client} can confirm or correct
readme.evidence_text: Every fact row names the place where it can be traced – file and line, document page or table cell.
readme.aggregates_text: Every figure, count and share is an Excel formula over the detail sheets. When a detail row changes, the overview and the management summary follow automatically.
readme.glossary_text: Standard = documented capability of the vendor product in the stated version. Custom = built or to be built for {engagement.client}. Location = file (with a line range where useful), document page or table cell where a statement can be traced.
readme.glossary_assumptions: A-nn = assumption {engagement.client} can confirm or correct (sheet “{assumptions_sheet}”).
readme.claims_text: Internal edition only: every claim on the sheet “{claims_sheet}” was scored 0–10 by independent reviewers – one against the client's own material, one or more against the external standard. A deliverable is released only when every reviewer's average reaches {threshold} and no claim was refuted. The review notes stay in the internal review notes.
readme.questions_text: Internal edition only: the sheet “{questions_sheet}” lists every question to the client with its status (open / answered / unresolvable) and answer type: “Decision” = set as fact by the engagement lead, “Working assumption” = proposal the analysis proceeds under, “Stated by {engagement.client}” = answered by the client. In the customer edition every question the client has not answered appears as an assumption.

sheet_texts.assumptions: Assumptions the results rest on – please confirm each row (yes / no / partly) and comment where needed; the affected rows are named
sheet_texts.sources: Vendor documentation the results rely on ([Qn]), with address and check date
sheet_texts.open_questions: Questions to the client with status, answer type and answer (internal edition only)
sheet_texts.claims: Every claim with the reviewer scores (internal edition only)

mgmt.heading: Assessment and recommendation
mgmt.missing: The assessment follows once the analysis is complete.

assumptions.name: Assumptions
assumptions.comment_prompt: Free text, e.g. an addition or a restriction
